source: BMC Infectious Diseases Spatiotemporal Dynamics Cholera DRC 1973-2022
processing_notes: Source states: 'In eastern DRC, cases were first imported in September 1977 in Kalemie, in Tanganyika Province, from Kigoma in Tanzania.
